name: Jolly: Let's Party
storyline:
A recent college graduate, 23-year-old Michelle Murdock moves to Oregon to start her independent life, so to begin with, she takes a job as a night guard at the renovated Jolly's Fantasy World

Note: The venue was reportedly closed years ago in 2017 due to the destruction of the Fantasy animatronics, and Jolly Entertainment had been struggling since then until they decided to reopen the Oregon location to return to the public eye with a new line of animatronics, the PartyTronics.
summary:
Come and spend your nights in our remodeled old place and take care of our new mascots, the Partytronics.

During your shift you will have access to a flashlight with unlimited battery life, unlimited internet, and your own uniform, along with an office specifically designed to keep you safe.

Beware: the company is not responsible for any injury, scratch, or trauma you receive during your working hours!
